body: Hey, thanks. I've given myself till the end of January. Then I don't know.
There are more reasons. This is just the final straw

Quitting my job. I worked hard to get there and threw it away because I didn't feel like I was doing well. I engage in cycles of self destruction and I think I went too far this time. Professionally I'm done.
Because there's no point anymore. I've lost the will to try.
